solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Festival crowd took Ecstasy

blocks.note: a jam is a dense crush of people or traffic
bore is the past tense of bear, to carry or take
E is the slang abbreviation for the drug ecstasy

explanation.surface: At a music festival the crowd were taking drugs.
explanation.definitionFit: A jamboree is a large lively gathering or celebration, such as a Scout rally, so it is a kind of festival.

clue.text: Religious footwasher, reluctant dishwasher?

blocks.note: first meaning, read playfully: the cloth Jesus used to wash his disciples' feet, a J for Jesus cloth
second meaning: the throwaway wipe grabbed by someone who would rather not wash up properly

explanation.walkthrough: Jesus washed his disciples' feet with a towel, so the first half playfully reads the brand name as 'Jesus cloth'. A J-cloth is a British brand of disposable kitchen wipe.
explanation.definitionFit: A J-cloth is a branded thin disposable cleaning cloth used for wiping dishes and surfaces.

clue.text: One packs old sports car with limited amount, moving abroad

indicators.note: something packed into another thing is put inside it

blocks.note: MG is a classic British sports car marque
I is the Roman numeral one
a ration is a fixed, limited allowance

explanation.surface: Someone loading a limited amount of luggage into a vintage sports car to move overseas.
explanation.definitionFit: Migration is the movement of people or animals from one country or region to another.

clue.text: Film father went to, Brando not bad for a change

indicators.note: not means without, so the word bad is taken away from the name before it
changing something alters it, so the letters are rearranged

blocks.note: the words taken as written
taken as written, before the removal

explanation.surface: Dad went to see a Brando film, which turned out not bad for a change.
explanation.walkthrough: Removing B, A and D from Brando leaves RNO, which joins the other twelve letters to be rearranged.
explanation.definitionFit: On the Waterfront is the 1954 film starring Marlon Brando as a dockworker.

clue.text: Case of SARS maybe disturbed House of Representatives

indicators.note: a case surrounds its contents, so only the outer letters of the next word are used
something disturbed is moved out of place, so these letters are jumbled

blocks.note: the word to be rearranged
the first and last letters

explanation.surface: A possible SARS case causes alarm in the US House of Representatives.
explanation.walkthrough: The two outer letters sit inside the rearranged word. The definition is not Congress but a house of diplomatic representatives.
explanation.definitionFit: An embassy is the building where a country's ambassador and diplomatic representatives work abroad.

clue.text: Terribly rude is how one appears online

indicators.note: something done terribly is done badly, so the letters come out in a messed-up order

blocks.note: the letters to rearrange

explanation.surface: A remark about someone who behaves rudely on the internet.
explanation.definitionFit: A user ID is the name or handle by which a person is identified on a website or network.

clue.text: Heavy smoker usually seen dragging?

blocks.note: surface: a person who smokes a lot; setter's reading: a big machine pouring out smoke
surface: always taking a drag on a cigarette; setter's reading: hauling carriages along a railway

explanation.walkthrough: A drag is a puff on a cigarette, which makes the dragging look like more smoking; really it is pulling a train.
explanation.definitionFit: A steam-powered railway engine is heavy, belches smoke and pulls a train of carriages or wagons.

clue.text: Look for food in the dirt around small hen-house

indicators.note: around means surrounding, so one piece wraps the other

blocks.clueFragment: Look for food in the dirt
blocks.note: pigs root, digging in the soil for food
S is the abbreviation for small

explanation.surface: Chickens scratching in the dirt for food around their little coop.
explanation.definitionFit: A roost is a perch or shelter where hens settle to sleep, so a hen-house.

clue.text: To choose blind, pull many across the window?

blocks.note: to draw is to pull, as one draws curtains across a window
lots means many
surface padding that completes the curtain-drawing picture and supplies no letters

explanation.surface: Choosing a window blind, then pulling lots of them across the window.
explanation.walkthrough: Blind looks like a window blind, which the curtain-drawing picture supports; really it means choosing without seeing. 'Across the window' just extends that picture.
explanation.definitionFit: To draw lots is to decide by picking slips or straws at random, without knowing the outcome.

clue.text: Heat in the afternoon outside about fifty-one

indicators.note: outside means on the outer side, so one piece wraps around the rest

blocks.note: p.m. marks times after noon
re means about or concerning
LI is the Roman numeral for fifty-one

explanation.surface: The temperature in the afternoon stood around fifty-one degrees.
explanation.walkthrough: Heat looks like temperature, but it is a qualifying round of a race.
explanation.definitionFit: A prelim, short for preliminary, is a qualifying round, like a heat in athletics.

clue.text: Proper bolt on foot

blocks.note: first meaning: legitimate, above board, in slang
second meaning, read as two words: to run away on one's legs

explanation.surface: Sounds like a carpenter approving a properly fitted bolt on a table leg.
explanation.walkthrough: Split as LEG IT, the phrase is British slang for running off; as one word it is short for legitimate.
explanation.definitionFit: Legit is informal for legitimate or genuine, while 'leg it' is colloquial for fleeing quickly on foot.

clue.text: Tesla owner in California backs local football team

indicators.note: one thing being in another means it sits inside it
to back something is to come behind it, so this part follows the next one

blocks.note: a local is one's neighbourhood pub, and a pub is a bar
CA is the postal abbreviation for California
Elon Musk owns the car maker Tesla

explanation.surface: A tech billionaire based in California sponsoring a hometown football club.
explanation.walkthrough: A local is British for one's regular pub. The California part, with Elon inside, comes after the pub.
explanation.definitionFit: FC Barcelona is the famous Spanish football club from the Catalan capital.

clue.text: Crossing South Africa during journey

indicators.note: something during a period happens within it, so one piece goes inside the other

blocks.note: a journey is travel
RSA is the Republic of South Africa

explanation.surface: Someone crossing South Africa in the course of a trip.
explanation.definitionFit: A traversal is the act of going across something, which is a crossing.

clue.text: Motorway delayed Rolling Stones on the road

indicators.note: rolling things tumble about, so the letters turn over into a new order

blocks.note: M is the British label for a motorway, as in the M1
delayed means late

explanation.surface: Traffic on the motorway made the Rolling Stones late for their tour.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Rolling Stones' looks like the band, but Rolling is the signal and Stones begins the definition. Road metal is broken stone for surfacing roads.
explanation.definitionFit: Metal, or road metal, is the crushed stone laid as the base of a road surface, so it is stones on the road.

clue.text: Set on fire one unspecified catalogue

blocks.note: lit is the past tense of light, to set on fire
any means one, no matter which

explanation.surface: Somebody torching a random catalogue.
explanation.definitionFit: A litany is a long tedious list or recital, so a catalogue of things.

clue.text: Attack after second satellite's disappearance

indicators.note: after says one part comes later in the word than the other

blocks.note: a mo is a moment, a second
an onset is an attack or assault

explanation.surface: Reads like a military report of an assault after a second satellite vanished.
explanation.definitionFit: Moonset is the moon dropping below the horizon, and the moon is Earth's satellite.

clue.text: Long running show, very good each time

blocks.note: so as an exclamation of approval can mean very good, all right
a pop is slang for each, as in five pounds a pop
an era is a period of time

explanation.surface: A TV show that has been running for years and is very good every time.
explanation.definitionFit: A soap opera is a serial drama broadcast for years, the archetypal long-running television show.

clue.text: Courier company approves move to another address

blocks.note: UPS is the parcel delivery firm United Parcel Service
to tick something is to mark it approved

explanation.surface: A delivery firm signing off a change of address.
explanation.walkthrough: Up sticks is British slang for packing up and moving house.
explanation.definitionFit: To up sticks is to relocate suddenly, packing up and moving home to live somewhere else.

clue.text: Sharp wordplay, Guy

blocks.note: a pun is a piece of wordplay
a guy is a man, a gent

explanation.surface: The setter Guy praising his own keen wordplay.
explanation.walkthrough: Guy is also the setter's pseudonym, which makes the clue look like a signature.
explanation.definitionFit: Pungent describes something with a sharp, strong smell or taste, or cutting wit.

clue.text: Listening to Piaf, say, her stamp?

definitions.note: what one attends to when listening to a singer; a noun is needed

blocks.note: first meaning: the tone quality of a voice heard when a singer like Piaf performs
second meaning: the French word for a postage stamp, Piaf being French

explanation.walkthrough: Edith Piaf was a French singer, so 'her stamp' asks for the French word, which is also the English musical term for tone colour.
explanation.definitionFit: Timbre is the distinctive tonal quality of a voice or instrument, and in French it means a postage stamp.

clue.text: Note hospital on low funds

indicators.note: in a down entry one thing on another sits above it, so here the pieces follow it

blocks.note: to low is to moo, as cattle do
la is a note of the sol-fa scale
H is the map abbreviation for hospital

explanation.surface: A hospital that is running short of money.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Low funds' reads as one phrase, but low is the cow's call.
explanation.definitionFit: Moolah is slang for money, so it means funds.

clue.text: Knife marks pine tree's bark

indicators.note: bark is the outer layer of a tree, so only the word's outer letters are used

blocks.note: M is an abbreviation for marks, the old German currency
to pine is to yearn, to ache
the first and last letters of the word

explanation.surface: A knife has left marks scored on a pine tree's bark.
explanation.definitionFit: A machete is a broad heavy knife used for cutting vegetation.

clue.text: Toast former Tory PM, with Labour leader getting in

indicators.note: the leader of a word is the letter at its front
getting in means entering, so this letter goes inside the name

blocks.note: Edward Heath was Conservative prime minister from 1970 to 1974
the opening letter

explanation.surface: Raising a glass to an old Conservative prime minister with the Labour leader joining in.
explanation.walkthrough: Tory means Conservative in British politics.
explanation.definitionFit: 'Your health!' is a common toast, so health is the word said when raising a glass.

clue.text: Criminal boss? Time for new leader

indicators.note: a new leader means the opening letter is swapped out for another one

blocks.note: a boss is a chief
T is the abbreviation for time

explanation.surface: Asks whether a gang boss is due to be replaced.
explanation.walkthrough: The first letter of the word for boss is replaced by the letter for Time.
explanation.definitionFit: A thief is someone who steals, so a criminal.

clue.text: Secret wife kept from Victor

indicators.note: something kept from a person is withheld from them, so it is taken away

blocks.note: a victor is a winner
W is the abbreviation for wife

explanation.surface: A man named Victor hiding a secret wife.
explanation.walkthrough: Victor looks like a man's name, but it means winner.
explanation.definitionFit: Inner can mean private or hidden, as in inner feelings kept secret from others.

clue.text: Tiny hole I cut to size in seconds

indicators.note: something in another thing sits inside it

blocks.note: seconds are a further helping of food, more
taken as written
to crop is to cut something down to size

explanation.surface: A tailor saying they trimmed a tiny hole to size very quickly.
explanation.walkthrough: 'In seconds' suggests speed, but seconds are second helpings, and the rest goes inside.
explanation.definitionFit: A micropore is a microscopic hole or pore, so a tiny hole.

clue.text: Fiddle lessons in large hall

blocks.note: a fiddle is a swindle, a con
a course is a series of lessons

explanation.surface: Violin lessons taking place in a big hall.
explanation.walkthrough: Fiddle looks like the violin, but it is the swindle sense.
explanation.definitionFit: A concourse is a large open hall in a public building such as a station.

clue.text: Trade with India as good as it could be?

definitions.text: as good as it could be?

blocks.note: India is I in the NATO phonetic alphabet
to trade is to deal

explanation.surface: Asks whether a trade agreement with India is the best possible outcome.
explanation.definitionFit: Ideal means perfect, the best that something could possibly be.

clue.text: Ship's sides bother fish

indicators.note: the sides of a word are its edges, so only its outermost letters are used

blocks.note: the first and last letters of the word
rats is an exclamation of annoyance, like bother

explanation.surface: The hull of a ship being pestered by fish.
explanation.definitionFit: Sprats are small silvery fish of the herring family.

clue.text: Page breaks spoiled the tale, thought reader

indicators.note: something that breaks into a group pushes its way inside it
something spoiled is ruined, so the letters are jumbled out of their order

blocks.note: P is the abbreviation for page
the letters to be rearranged

explanation.surface: A page break ruined the story, someone muses.
explanation.definitionFit: A telepath is someone who can supposedly read other people's thoughts.
